page.overview:
Who is Deku Butler?

The is a character in . was referred to as the Butler on Zelda.com's encyclopedia. However, as this contradicts the name given in , it is not considered Canon.}}

The is the loyal servant of the , who lives in the . He is very proper and polite and is able to keep his head much better than the he serves. Prior to the events of , the used to race with his , who eventually left his home without a trace, leaving the worried.

When arrives at the , the comments at the sad state the from finds itself in. This from having a kidnapped , a poisoned , and a who will not listen to reason and is only willing to blame the for the 's disappearance. Moreover, the fears that the has been caught up in trouble, but since the is unwilling to calm down, the cannot send out troops to look for her. Here, the leads through a labyrinth full of traps. If the young hero manages to keep up, the will apologize for trying to outrun him, saying he was reminded of when he used to race his son, and will give him the .

During the end credits, the is seen mourning at a twisted found in the that leads to the . This is the same one that comments on at the beginning of the game. Apparently, the had come across the at that spot and stripped him of his soul, which he later used to transform into a .
